title: Battle of Tabocas
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Tabocas", at revision 1370590318, opens: "The Battle of Tabocas, also known as the Battle of Mount Tabocas, was fought between the Dutch and the Portuguese army." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4872481, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1645 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
